requirement: Provide a web application supported by a back-end database for case, itinerary, and association data, an algorithm module for regional flow and clustering analysis, and geographic visualization for locations and paths.

The system shall provide a reporting pipeline that captures, formats, submits, stores, and makes available for analysis epidemiological investigation records including basic case information, disease-related information, itinerary trajectory information, and optional imported-case information.

The system shall support case management by displaying case records, searching, sorting, and filtering them, and by allowing existing case information to be completed or corrected, including the completion-status view.

The system shall support itinerary investigation assistance by querying historical itinerary data, prompting detailed activity locations when a case cannot recall them, displaying ambiguous addresses on a map for confirmation, and visualizing case itineraries.
The system shall support individual case association analysis by filtering associated cases using spatial and temporal thresholds and by presenting a confirmed-case-centered relationship graph.

The system shall support outbreak-level analysis by checking whether case data is sufficient, returning errors and management prompts when data is problematic, and generating regional flow maps and case clustering graphs through the algorithm module.
Display outbreak heat maps, temperature and humidity trends, age and occupation distributions, and transportation statistics using the relevant case, stopover, and climate data.
The system shall protect personal-information queries through encrypted handling and throttle frequent query IPs to reduce resource abuse and protect normal reporting and analysis.
The system shall tolerate abnormal or out-of-spec input without crashing.
